fr-2023-12789.orig: Bureau of Political-Military Affairs; Statutory Debarment Under the Arms Export Control Act and the International Traffic in Arms Regulations
fr-2023-12789.quote: "Notice is hereby given that the Department of State has imposed statutory debarment under the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) on persons convicted of violating, or conspiracy to violate, the Arms Export Control Act (AECA)."

fr-2024-12481.title: 1991년 화학·생물무기 통제 및 전쟁 근절법에 따른 러시아의 화학무기 사용 관련 판정
fr-2024-12481.orig: Determinations Regarding Use of Chemical Weapons by Russia Under the Chemical and Biological Weapons Control and Warfare Elimination Act of 1991
fr-2024-12481.quote: "The Acting Under Secretary of State for Political Affairs, acting under authority delegated pursuant to an Executive order, has determined pursuant to section 306(a) of the Chemical and Biological Weapons Control and Warfare Elimination Act of 1991 (the Act), that the Government of the Russian Federation has used chemical weapons in violation of international law."
fr-2024-12481.ko: 정무 담당 국무부 차관 직무대행은 행정명령에 따라 위임된 권한으로 행위하여, 1991년 화학·생물무기 통제 및 전쟁 제거법(이하 이 법) 제306조(a)에 따라 러시아 연방 정부가 국제법을 위반하여 화학무기를 사용하였다고 판단하였다.
